parts.title: Morning at the Lake
parts.text: Mabel, Dario, and Keiko went to the lake with Grandpa. The water was **glassy**, as smooth as a mirror. Mabel leaned over the dock and saw her **reflection** smiling back. Grandpa gave each child a fishing rod and a small box.

parts.title: Getting Ready
parts.text: Dario picked a shiny **lure** that looked like a tiny fish. Keiko put a wiggly worm on her hook as **bait**. Grandpa showed them how to **cast**. “Pull back, then swing forward,” he said. Keiko's red **bobber** landed with a **plop**. She let her feet **dangle** over the edge of the dock and waited.

parts.title: A Little Surprise
parts.text: Suddenly the bobber gave a **twitch**. “I think I have a fish!” Keiko shouted, and she began to **reel** in her line. Out came a tiny **minnow**, no bigger than a finger. She smiled and set it back in the water. Then Dario's line got a **snag** on an old log, and Grandpa helped him pull it free.

parts.title: Golden Evening
parts.text: The sun began to sink, and the lake turned gold. They had not caught a big fish, but they had laughed all day. Grandpa said the best part of fishing is the quiet time together.
